nl: Find university alumni born before a given date who work at more than the threshold number of companies, then count their recently created one- or two-hop KNOWS contacts by network attributes.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company) WHERE p.birthday < $birthday WITH p, count(co) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE f.creationDate > $friendSince RETURN f.locationIP AS locationIP, f.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT p) AS workerCount

nl: Rank countries by the number of organisations located there, then count employees of local companies who have a specified interest by browser and gender.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation) WHERE co.name <> $excludedCountry AND org.name <> $excludedOrganisation WITH co, count(org) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag) WHERE p.creationDate > $personDate AND t.name = $interestTag RETURN p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, p.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT p) AS employeeCount
